## Masteries (Sets 1-7)
Saiyan / Namekian Masteries need an MP on the matching heritage list. Format: name | style | text.

Black Conflict Mastery | Black | [Continuous]: Your attacks that deal at least 4 life cards of damage are considered to deal critical damage. POWER: Discard a card from your hand. If that card was Styled, your MP gains 6 stages or you may raise or lower a player's anger 1 level.
Black Devious Mastery | Black | [Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 power stage and +1 life card of damage. POWER: Discard a card from your hand to banish the bottom 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile. If you discarded a Styled card, your opponent discards a card from his hand.
Black Perceptive Mastery | Black | [Continuous]: Your Styled attacks gain "HIT: Destroy an opponent's Setup or Drill." POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck to destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. If your opponent destroyed a Physical Combat or Energy Combat card, your MP gains 4 stages. Otherwise, raise a player's anger 1 level.
Blue Protective Mastery | Blue | [Continuous]: Your opponent needs 6 anger to advance a personality level. [Defense] POWER: You may discard a Physical Combat card from your hand to stop an energy attack or an Energy Combat card to stop a physical attack. If you discarded a Blue card, you may raise or lower a player's anger 1 level.
Blue Resolute Mastery | Blue | [Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 life card of damage. POWER: Discard a Styled card from your hand to draw a card and prevent 4 stages and 4 life cards of damage from your opponent's next attack this combat.
Blue Tag Team Mastery | Blue | (At the start of your opponent's first turn, search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it into play at 3 power stages above 0.) [Continuous]: While you control 1 Ally, it cannot be discarded by critical damage effects. [Instant] POWER: Use at the end of combat. Choose an Ally in your Banished Zone and Rejuvenate it.
Namekian Knowledge Mastery | Namekian | [Continuous]: Whenever one of your effects during combat Rejuvenates or shuffles cards into your Life Deck, raise your anger 1 level. After a Namek Dragon Ball enters play under your control, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. While you control 1 Dragon Ball, it cannot be captured by a critical damage effect.
Namekian Radiant Mastery | Namekian | [Continuous]: Whenever an Earth Dragon Ball you own enters play during combat, raise your anger 1 level. While 3 or more Earth Dragon Balls you own are in play, your attacks deal +2 life cards of damage. POWER: If less than 3 Dragon Balls you own are in play, search your Life Deck for a Dragon Ball and place it into play.
Namekian Restored Mastery | Namekian | [Instant] POWER: Use at the end of the turn. Reveal the bottom card of your Life Deck. If that card is Styled or a Dragon Ball, you may place it into your hand. If you do, place a card from your hand on the top or bottom of your Life Deck. POWER: Raise your anger 2 levels. You may discard a Dragon Ball or Styled card from your hand to shuffle your Life Deck and draw a card.
Orange Adaptive Mastery | Orange | [Continuous]: Your Drills are not discarded when you advance or lower a personality level. Your energy attacks deal +1 life card of damage. At the end of any combat in which you used a critical damage effect, search your discard pile for a Styled Drill and place it into play.
Orange Adept Mastery | Orange | [Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 stage of damage. After your MP advances a level, search your discard pile for a Drill and Rejuvenate it. [Instant] POWER: Use after performing a successful Styled attack. That attack gains "HIT: If you control 2 or less Drills, search your Life Deck for a Styled [Continuous] Drill and place it into play."
Orange Retribution Mastery | Orange | (You cannot activate the Power of a Drill with the same name as a Drill you have already activated this turn.) (At the start of your opponent's first turn, search your Life Deck for a Styled non-[Continuous] Drill and place it into play.) [Continuous]: Whenever your MP changes levels, you may shuffle all Drills you control into their owner's Life Deck. POWER: The next Styled attack you perform this combat has its power stage cost reduced to 0. Raise your anger up to 2 levels. If your MP has changed levels this combat, search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play.
Red Ascension Mastery | Red | [Continuous]: Whenever you use a critical damage effect, gain 2 stages. At the end of each combat, you may raise your anger 1 level. POWER: Banish the top card of your Life Deck to raise your anger 1 level. If you banished a Styled card, your opponent skips his or her next action this combat.
Red Enraged Mastery | Red | [Continuous]: Whenever you use a critical damage effect, raise your anger 1 level. Whenever you advance a personality level, draw a card and then discard a card from your hand. Whenever you lower a personality level, you may draw a card.
Red Ruthless Mastery | Red | [Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Banish the top card of your discard pile. If you banished a Styled card, your Styled physical attacks this combat deal +2 stages of damage and gain "HIT: Lower your opponent's anger 1 level." POWER: Reveal a Styled card from your hand and place it at the bottom of your Life Deck. If you do and the top card of your discard pile is an attack card, you may play it.
Saiyan Dynamic Mastery | Saiyan | (You may begin the game on Level 2.) [Continuous]: You need 6 anger to advance a personality level. Your Styled attacks without "anger" printed in the text-box gain "Raise your anger 1 level."
Saiyan Empowered Mastery | Saiyan | [Continuous]: You cannot win by MPPV. Your Saiyan Style attacks gain "Raise your anger 1 level. HIT: Gain 3 power stages." Whenever you Rejuvenate a Saiyan Style card, raise your anger 1 level.
Saiyan Rampaging Mastery | Saiyan | [Continuous]: You need 1 less anger to advance a personality level (to a minimum of 4). Your Styled attacks gain "HIT: You may raise your anger 1 level." POWER: Discard a Styled card with Endurance from your hand to perform a non-Styled physical attack dealing 1 +X stages of damage. X = the amount of Endurance on the discarded card.
